source: Published derived historical strategy ledger; underlying vendor-adjusted Yahoo Finance data

settings.breach: realized loss strictly greater than forecast VaR

interpretation: Strategy-return risk only, not a REIT valuation or a capital-charge model. Zero-return periods can collapse the trailing distribution; retain these days and report clustering. Tail mean with ties is a diagnostic, not exact fixed-mass Expected Shortfall. No calibration pass/fail or forward predictive validity is claimed.
